description: Issue a tamper-evident, Ed25519-signed budget certificate for an agent repo (re-run server-side, logged to a public transparency log). Same input as costwright_check plus an optional label. Returns the cert_id, the signed certificate and a verify_url. Use to produce an auditable proof of a workflow's worst-case spend ceiling.

label.description: Optional human label for the certificate.

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the local Python repo/directory to certify.

name: costwright_certify
